sloka: ततस्तु नीलः प्रतिलभ्य सञ्ज्ञां शैलं समुत्पाट्य सवृक्षषण्डम्।ततः समुत्पत्य भृशोग्रवेगो महोदरं तेन जघान मूर्ध्नि ।। ६.७०.३१ ।।
transliteration: tatastu nīlaḥ pratilabhya sañjñāṁ śailaṁ samutpāṭya savṛkṣaṣaṇḍam।tataḥ samutpatya bhṛśogravego mahodaraṁ tena jaghāna mūrdhni ।। 6.70.31 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter Neela also regained his senses and uprooting a mountain filled with trees went over Mahodara at high speed and attacked him on the forehead.
